premises.text: Presentation work is fragmented across PowerPoint, email, Slack, Drive/Dropbox, and separate present/share tools, causing version and formatting failures
premises.evidence_span: people are creating their presentation in PowerPoint, sharing it via email, having a conversation about it on Slack

premises.text: Slides is an end-to-end cloud platform with a new stacked-detail format and collaborative editor for creating presentations together
premises.evidence_span: Slides is an end-to-end platform for creating, presenting, and sharing presentations

premises.text: Built-in presenting and sharing tools deliver live, offline, link, and mobile-ready interactive decks that look good in any setting
premises.evidence_span: we've also built the best tools for presenting and sharing

premises.text: Team customization provides templates and shared media so creators focus on content rather than design tooling
premises.evidence_span: The Slides Editor has been completely customized to Jack's team

premises.text: Monetization spans free signup, individual and team plans, plus Enterprise behind the corporate firewall
premises.evidence_span: We offer plans for individuals and teams like Acme

value.text: Teams create better presentations by working together end-to-end in one platform
value.evidence_span: We make it easy to work together on presentations

causal_links.evidence_span: changed the way teams work together on presentations
Everyone can sign up for free and create presentations

notes: Tool-fragmentation pains folded as one problem bundle (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Live embeds, stacked details, comments, templates, team media, and interaction polish folded as feature cascade of the collaborative editor (§4.1.7); present/share/mobile kept as a related but speaker-emphasized complementary module within the product domain. User/visitor traction excluded. Anti-template: problem, product, and packaging separately revisable.
